paragraphs: Rabbah bar Rav Adda. Sukkah 3a. He reported Rav Adda’s teaching in Rav’s name (Menahot 39a). At Kiddushin 70a he reports a teaching of Rav. A nearby statement is alternatively attributed to R’ Salla in Rav Hamnuna’s name. Rava bar Rav Adda and Ravin bar Rav Adda in Rav's name: Yoma 53b. In Rav Yehudah's name: Ta'anit 24b, Rava. Rava bar Rav Adda and Ravin bar Rav Adda: ‘When we were in Rav Yehudah's house,’ Beitzah 33b. Rava bar Rav Adda said that R' Yitzhak said: Temurah 29a; Makkot 18, end of b. Rava bar Rav Adda, Pesahim 13a, should read Ravin. She'erit Yosef included him among Rav's pupils, because he spoke in Rav's name. But this is difficult, since he spoke in Rav Yehudah's name.
